listing.name: Daytona USA (Sega Model 2 arcade) (Daytona USA static recompilation)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Source setup builds locally from own ROM set on Windows/macOS/Linux; no GitHub releases. Limits: Playable desktop routes; experimental hardware renderer/link play/wheels. Android/iOS/Vita documented, Dreamcast only tested in Flycast. Setup installs toolchains/dependencies (Windows VS C++/Clang, mac Homebrew, Linux packages); updates require pulling and rerunning generation. Main builds have CI compile coverage, not a proof of runtime playthrough. Distinguish original arcade title from Daytona Championship USA or other console ports.... Upstream platforms: Documented local source-build route for Windows/macOS/Linux; no GitHub release package. Windows compiler/Clang and macOS/Linux toolchain setup required; selected host CPU coverage not mapped in frozen evidence. Original data: User-owned daytona93 (Deluxe93) or daytona (Revision A1994) MAME-format zip/7z; other sets rejected. Both generated privately. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
